programme.title: Portugueses Pelo Mundo T5 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Viajamos até Dakar, a capital do Senegal. Esta é uma cidade cujo nome é muito familiar aos amantes de desportos motorizados. Mas para além dos ralis, descobrimos um povo afável e feliz e uma cidade viva, cheia de mercados e com o mar ali à mão. 'Bem-vindos a Dacar!' Cândida Silva, 32 Anos, Voluntária das Nações Unidas, natural de Macedo de Cavaleiros.

programme.title: Amor De Perdição - Memórias De Uma Família - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Série adaptada do filme de Manoel de Oliveira e baseada no mais famoso romance de Camilo Castelo Branco que tem como base um triângulo amoroso. No início do século XIX, Simão Botelho e Teresa de Albuquerque, pertencendo a duas famílias rivais, amam-se apaixonadamente. Teresa está prometida a um primo seu, Baltazar Coutinho. A jovem decide entrar num convento. Simão mata Baltazar e é preso.

programme.title: Ver E Pensar T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Programa sobre a comemoração do Dia Mundial da Infância na sede do Movimento Democrático de Artistas Plásticos em Lisboa.

programme.title: Sinais De Vida - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Alice tenta salvar a vida de Fernanda, uma jovem de 19 anos que teve um acidente de viação e que está com uma hemorragia abdominal. O pai da rapariga não confia na equipa médica e quer transferir a filha de hospital. A sua pretensão fica inviabilizada porque já não há tempo. Já na sala de operações, Alice verifica que o fígado está muito atingido e o baço esmagado.

programme.title: Quebra-Cabeças T1 - Ep. 57
programme.desc: Concurso da RTP que garante a animação. Apresentado por Cristina Mohler, cada sessão começa com dois concorrentes. Para selecionar quem joga primeiro, é lançada no ar uma frase-puzzle que os concorrentes têm que resolver. Apurado o concorrente que dará início à primeira etapa do concurso, passa-se à fase das questões a serem jogadas pelos dois concorrentes, para assim se apurar aquele que, na segunda parte, vai jogar o Jackpot.

programme.title: Ora Viva! - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Escolinha do Elias vai de vento em popa e o trabalho esforçado de Juca começa a dar resultados. Nídia continua a sonhar e na tentativa de concretizar mais um sonho procura cativar Duarte. Serão os seus argumentos ou os de Ivone que finalmente o convencem? Laura aproxima-se de Elias, usando Quim, e Elias não consegue esquecer o passado que tanto o marcou.

programme.title: Roteiros De Portugal
programme.desc: 'Micro programas' apresentados por José António Salvador. Numa ronda por todo o país, Salvador propõe uma seleção de restaurantes, hotéis e locais a serem visitados.

programme.desc: Origens é a segunda telenovela portuguesa produzida e emitida pela RTP, a seguir a Vila Faia. Escrita por Nicolau Breyner, Francisco Nicholson, e Thilo Krasmann, Origens reunia os melhores atores da altura e foi um dos grandes sucessos da televisão portuguesa.

programme.title: Pai à Força T1 - Ep. 5

Filipe está apaixonado por Inês mas Miguel não dá grande ajuda à conquista pois está atrasado para uma cirurgia. Lourenço falha no bloco operatório e por pouco não mata um doente. Álvaro não tem alternativa e coloca-o sob alçada disciplinar.

programme.title: Claxon - Ep. 8
programme.desc: laxon tem entre mãos o caso de Dalila Pegaso, que tem recebido todas as noites, às três da manhã, misteriosos telefonemas anónimos. O interlocutor informa-a de que alguém vai morrer. E poucos minutos depois as pessoas são mortas, efetivamente. Atores convidados: Rosa Maria Pereira - Dalila Pegaso Alexandre Soares - Alex Maria João Pinto - Viúva de Jorge Martin Adelaide João - Tia de Dalila.

Treinou no Qatar e no Irão e agora é diretora desportiva do Estoril Praia.

programme.title: Lua Vermelha T1 - Ep. 162
programme.desc: Um colégio cravado no coração da Serra de Sintra. Uma instituição de renome, conhecida pela sua disciplina rigorosa, que forma rapazes e raparigas que estão em situação crítica ou que simplesmente são considerados diferentes (órfãos, problemáticos, sobredotados), e por isso não se enquadram no sistema escolar regular. É um colégio onde se vão viver todos os problemas e aventuras que marcam a transição para a idade adulta.

programme.title: O Conselheiro
programme.desc: Determinado a subir na vida seja a que preço for, um advogado americano deixa-se envolver no perigoso mundo do tráfico de estupefacientes. Assim, aliciado pelo lucro fácil, parte para o México, onde faz negócio com Reiner, um poderoso barão da droga que tem em mãos um carregamento de cocaína avaliado em mais de 20 milhões de dólares. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Magnum P.I. T2 - Ep. 16

programme.title: Magnum P.I. T2 - Ep. 17

Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Magnum P.I. T2 - Ep. 18

E ainda, Rick ajuda um soldado reformado com a difícil tarefa de voltar ao trabalho como civil. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Magnum P.I. T2 - Ep. 19

programme.title: Animal Control T2 - Ep. 8

programme.title: Evil T4 - Ep. 8

programme.title: Hawai Força Especial T10 - Ep. 18

E ainda, Quinn ajuda Noelani quando ela suspeita que o tio não morreu de causas naturais. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Hawai Força Especial T10 - Ep. 19

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Wolfgang Probst, Motti Kastón, Bernhard Schneider, Robert Künzli, Esa Ruuttunen, Eberhard Francesco Lorenz and Roland Bracht.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: During the years when Bach was in the service of the courts of Prince Leopold in Köthen, he had his own orchestra and was contracted to compose a great deal of instrumental music. This gave him an opportunity to try new techniques and to develop his own instrumental style. The six Brandenburg Concertos belongs to these masterpieces which he composed for a small ensemble .

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Dvorák - Violin Concerto in A minor, Op. 53
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Telemann - Jesus liegt in letzten Zügen, TWV 1:983
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 4
programme.desc: Discover the soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37 and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41, accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera. Conducted by Marc Andreae, the performance took place at the historic Teatro Bibiena in Mantua.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Organ works by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: German organist Ullrich Böhme performs various organ works by J. S. Bach at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in this concert recording from 2000. St. Thomas Church is associated with several composers, including Felix Mendelssohn and Richard Wagner, but most especially with J. S. Bach, who was ‘Thomaskantor’ from 1723 until his death in 1750.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Diepenbrock, Fauré a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Wanderlied’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Der Abend kommt gezogen’ from Alphons Diepenbrock’s Drie ballades, Op. 1; Gabriel Fauré’s Prison, Op. 83, No. 1; ‘Ganymed’ from Hugo Wolf’s Goethe-Lieder; Franz Schubert’s Nacht und Träume, D. 827; Zaiyi Lu’s The bridge in my homeland; ‘Mit Myrten und Rosen’ from Schumann’s Liederkreis, Op.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 9, Op. 95
programme.desc: Latvian conductor Andris Nelsons leads the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95, ‘From the New World’. Dvorák wrote this famous symphony in 1893, during his three-year term as Director of the National Conservatory of Music in New York. The Conservatory had hired the nationalist composer to create a new, national style of art music for the United States.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 & 2
programme.desc: Star pianist Daniel Barenboim performs the first and second books of Isaac Albéniz’s piano suite Iberia. Composed between 1905 and 1908, Iberia is in four books of three pieces each. This masterpiece paints twelve musical portraits of Spanish regions, traditions, and atmospheres. This performance was recorded at the Teatro Colón in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on August 19, 2000.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Music by Beethoven
programme.desc: Three of classical music's most beloved stars gather for a concert devoted entirely to Beethoven's music, recorded in 1995 at the Berliner Philharmonie by Barrie Gavin. Daniel Barenboim (piano), Yo-Yo Ma (cello) and Itzhak Perlman (violin) perform the Triple Concerto, op. 56 and the Fantaisie chorale, op. 80.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo & Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled 'Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe,' which translates to 'Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love'), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St.

programme.title: Lucky Chops - Live at BIRD
programme.desc: The NYC band Lucky Chops rose to fame when a video of their performance at a subway station went viral on YouTube in 2015. Since then, the energetic quintet has been entertaining audiences all over the world. The band was formed in 2006, when trumpeter Joshua Gawel, saxophonist Daro Behroozi, trombonist Josh Holcomb, tubist Raphael Buyo, and drummer Charles Sams, met during their education at Fiorello H.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets & Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Klezmer to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Taking It Back & Nobody
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Milonga Noctiva
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Voyage
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Rita Reys & The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: M.Eilertsen Trio & Trio Mediaeval - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers & The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 & 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Love X Love
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Humphrey's Smile
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Julia Kadel
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Manu Katché - The scOpe
programme.desc: Manu Katché is one of France's most famous jazz drummers, who originally studied piano at the Conservatory in Paris before he switched to percussion. He presented his tenth album, “The scOpe”, which incorporates elements of jazz, rock, and world music, at the 2020 edition of Festival Jazz au Sommet in France.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Milky Chance - Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album 'Blossom'. And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, 'Live At Wolf Trap' captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of 'Rock N Roll Damnation' and 'What's Next To The Moon' and more.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers - Live at Montreux 2013
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Mary J. Blige - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Carrie Underwood - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Watch Carrie Underwood performing live at the Apple Music Festival. What a unique concert experience, not only for the fans at the Roundhouse, but also for fans across the globe!.

programme.title: Michael Kiwanuka - Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: Watch Michael Kiwanuka's performance at the Garorock Festival in 2017.

programme.title: Metallica - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: Master of Puppets is the third studio album released by American thrash metal / heavy metal band Metallica, released March 3, 1986.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela - Garorock Festival 2014
programme.desc: The mexican duet takes the stage at Garorock Festival, in July 2014.

programme.title: Muse - Live at Festival Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Muse.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live from Nokia Times Square
programme.desc: Rod Stewart performs tracks from his 'Still the Same... Great Rock Classics of Our Time' album Live at the NYC Nokia Theater on 9 October 2006.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Céline Dion - Celine Dion - Taking Chances World Tour
programme.desc: Part of the world tour of Celine Dion, which was seen by more than 3 million people and covered 5 continents, 25 countries and 92 cities - the first tour in nine years that was an absolute success. Enjoy the biggest hits of the decade's most important artist: 'Because You Loved Me', 'All By Myself', 'My Heart Will Go On', 'I Drove All Night' and others!.

programme.title: Snow Patrol - Live At Somerset House
programme.desc: With their third album, 'Final Straw', selling a cool 1.5 million in the UK in its year of release, Snow Patrol's reputation as a remarkable band remains intact. 'Live At Somerset House' reveals why the band is praised for delivering fantastic live performances. It also places them at one of London's most gorgeous settings which complements the band's distinctive and provocative sound perfectly.

programme.title: The Legend
programme.desc: Um praticante de kung fu participa de um concurso para conquistar a filha de um mercador, enquanto enfrenta a perseguição de um governador que caça membros de uma sociedade secreta.

programme.title: A Ressaca

programme.title: A Ressaca - Parte 2

programme.title: A Ressaca - Parte III
programme.desc: Passaram-se dois anos. Phil, Stu e Doug vivem uma vida tranquila. O único descontente é Alan, que deixou de tomar os medicamentos e voltou aos instintos naturais. Desta vez, não há casamento. Não há despedida de solteiro. Então, o que pode correr mal?.

programme.title: Madame Claude

programme.title: O Ritual

programme.title: O Sétimo Selo

programme.title: O Futuro de Inglaterra

programme.desc: Outlander T8 - Ep. 9

programme.title: TNT Jackson
programme.desc: TNT Jackson, uma especialista em artes marciais, viaja de Harlem para Hong Kong para descobrir o paradeiro do irmão desaparecido, enfrentando gangues, tráfico e traições numa mistura de ação e erotismo clássica dos anos 70.

programme.title: Além do Jogo
programme.desc: Em 1955, cinco jovens caddies mexicanos-americanos, apaixonados pelo jogo, estavam determinados a aprender a jogar, pelo que criaram o seu próprio campo de golfe no meio do deserto do Sul do Texas.

programme.title: Surpresa de Natal - O Milagre de Tina
programme.desc: A bem-sucedida proprietária de uma loja de embrulhos, Tina, está encarregue de planear a gala anual de Natal deste ano. Mas as coisas começam a correr mal quando a gala é cancelada por causa de um proprietário desprezível..

programme.title: Reveses da Fortuna
programme.desc: O brilhante professor de direito Alan Dershowitz é contratado pelo milionário Claus Von Bulow, para o defender das acusações de assassinato da sua mulher. Mas como se defende alguém que acreditamos ser culpado? Baseado numa história verídica.

programme.title: A Época mais Colorida do Ano
programme.desc: Um professor descobre que é daltónico. Com a ajuda de uma oftalmologista, e mãe de um dos seus alunos, ele volta a ver o mundo cheio de cor.. mesmo a tempo do Natal.

programme.title: A Idade Do Gelo 2 - Descongelados
programme.desc: As aventuras de Diego, Manny e Sid, três amigos improváveis, prosseguem. Agora tentam escapar aos perigosos degelos que ameaçam a Terra e as suas espécies.

programme.title: Histórias De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Em 1919, numa pequena cidade, um herói de guerra é mantido preso. À porta um cão ladra dia e noite. Não muito longe, uma jovem trabalha na terra; e um juíz está prestes a resolver um caso. Três personagens e um cão que esconde a chave do seu destino.

programme.title: Os Guardiões Do Museu
programme.desc: Vicent, o gato, e Maurice, o rato, vivem numa ilha até uma inundação os arrastar para o museu Hermitage. Lá, juntam-se aos Guardiões do Museu, gatos que detestam ratos, para proteger a Mona Lisa de um plano perigoso.

programme.title: Surpresa de Natal - O Destino de Lily
programme.desc: Com as responsabilidades do Natal a acumularem-se, Lily, dona de uma loja de embrulhos para presentes, aceita ansiosamente um encontro com um bonito agente imobiliário local. Mas será ele o único que a vai arrebatar?.

programme.title: Reveses da Fortuna
programme.desc: O brilhante professor de direito Alan Dershowitz é contratado pelo milionário Claus Von Bulow, para o defender das acusações de assassinato da sua mulher. Mas como se defende alguém que acreditamos ser culpado? Baseado numa história verídica.

programme.title: Salvar a Quinta no Natal
programme.desc: Quando o contabilista da pousada de Natal da família de Carrie Williams foge com todo o dinheiro, Carrie tem apenas dois dias para pagar nove meses de hipoteca em falta ou será penhorada.

programme.title: A Idade Do Gelo 4: Deriva Continental
programme.desc: O faminto esquilo Scrat provoca a separação dos continentes devido a sua fixação pela bolota. Manny, Diego e Sid estão à deriva em alto mar e têm de lutar contra terríveis piratas, determinados a impedir que o grupo encontre o caminho de casa.

programme.title: A Idade Do Gelo: O Big Bang
programme.desc: A épica perseguição de Scrat pela bolota acaba por levá-lo até ao espaço, onde acidentalmente desencadeia uma série de eventos cósmicos que transformam e ameaçam o Mundo da Idade do Gelo.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace é uma finalista de liceu ansiosa por ir de férias para Paris com a sua melhor amiga Emma e a meia-irmã Meg. Quando Grace é confundida com uma rica socialite, as três são levadas para Monte Carlo, para uma semana de brilho, glamour e diversão.

programme.title: Música e Letra
programme.desc: Um antigo elemento de um popular grupo dos anos 1980 junta-se à palavrosa Sophie para comporem uma canção destinada a uma jovem estrela da pop.

programme.title: Chicago Med T11 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Hannah enfrenta um dos desafios mais difíceis da sua carreira. Frost enfrenta momentos difíceis.

programme.title: Mentes Brilhantes T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O Dr. Wolf trata os sintomas inexplicáveis de um lutador de MMA, enquanto o Dr. Pierce explora oportunidades de emprego fora do Bronx General.

programme.title: Umas Férias à Força
programme.desc: Para escapar à polícia, pai e filho refugiam-se num campo de férias para jovens com deficiência, fazendo-se passar por um dos frequentadores do campo e um educador. Entre sarilhos e encontros improváveis, vivem uma experiência humana transformadora.

programme.title: Almas Marcadas
programme.desc: Ela, estudante exemplar de família rica. Ele, tatuador rebelde e livre. Uma noite inesperada une-os e obriga-os a enfrentar segredos, luto e medo de amar. Conseguirá a paixão superar mundos tão diferentes?.

programme.title: Estamos no Ar
programme.desc: Um filho, a sua mãe tímida e a sua avó infeliz partilham o desejo de uma vida diferente daquela que têm. Eles são obrigados a viver essa vida nos seus sonhos, fantasias ou online.

programme.title: Animale
programme.desc: Nejma, jovem criadora de touros em Camargue, treina para vencer a tradicional corrida de touros dominada por homens. Após uma noite misteriosa, percebe mudanças perturbadoras e um touro selvagem começa a aterrorizar a comunidade.

programme.title: Emilia Pérez
programme.desc: Rita, uma advogada subvalorizada, recebe uma proposta inesperada: ajudar Manitas, líder de um cartel, a abandonar o crime e concretizar o seu plano secreto de anos – tornar-se a mulher que sempre sonhou ser.

programme.title: Casa Comigo em Yosemite
programme.desc: A fotojornalista Zoe viaja para Yosemite para capturar paisagens icónicas inspiradas por Ansel Adams. Lá, conhece Jack, um guia turístico com quem embarca numa jornada que transforma as suas vidas de maneira inesperada.

programme.title: A Lenda do Medalhão Perdido
programme.desc: Quando uma especialista em antiguidades se lança numa missão para encontrar um medalhão há muito perdido que promete trazer ao seu portador o verdadeiro amor, ela vê-se em conflito com o xerife da cidade, mas também atraída por ele.

programme.title: A Herdeira e o Faz-tudo
programme.desc: Depois de perder a sua fortuna, uma herdeira muda-se para uma quinta rural onde confunde o seu bonito vizinho com o faz-tudo. Para estar à altura do legado da família, ele ajuda-a a competir na feira do condado.

programme.title: Pequenos Clarões
programme.desc: Quando a filha pede que Isabel cuide do ex-marido doente após 15 anos separados, ressentimentos antigos explodem. Lutando contra o passado, ela enfrenta o inesperado. Baseado no conto de Eider Rodríguez.

programme.title: O Fantasma da Liberdade
programme.desc: Numa Toledo ocupada pelas forças napoleónicas, um soldado abraça uma estátua feminina numa igreja. Depois, exige que se abra o caixão. A história é contada por um criado num jardim público, que prefere ler em vez de tomar conta das filhas dos patrões, os Foucault.

programme.title: Um Brinde ao Amor
programme.desc: Stella desenha chapéus e adornos para a socialite Rosalind quando conhece o seu filho Christian, que está a treinar um cavalo para competir no Louisville Derby.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Louca por Ele
programme.desc: Bridget, viúva há quatro anos, é mãe solteira de Billy e Mabel. Pressionada pelos amigos, família e colegas, entra no mundo dos encontros online. Entre gafes e dilemas maternos, Bridget descobre que o amor nem sempre segue um plano perfeito.

programme.title: Lights Out - Terror na Escuridão
programme.desc: Quado o irmão mais novo de Rebecca começa a viver os mesmos inexplicáveis e aterradores episódios que outrora ela viveu, sempre que as luzes se apagavam, uma entidade assustadora, com uma misteriosa ligação à mãe dos irmãos, reaparece.

programme.title: The Smashing Machine: Coração de Lutador
programme.desc: Mark Kerr, lendário lutador de MMA (interpretado por Dwayne Johnson), enfrenta o auge da fama enquanto luta contra vícios e dilemas pessoais — um campeão nos ringues, mas em guerra com os seus próprios demónios.

programme.title: Bonecas em Fuga
programme.desc: Duas amigas, Jamie e Marian, procuram esquecer os seus problemas durante uma viagem improvisada até Tallahassee. Mas os planos são interrompidos quando se cruzam com um grupo de desastrados criminosos.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nova Iorque, 1961. Um jovem Bob Dylan surge com a sua guitarra e um talento revolucionário, estabelecendo relações com ícones da música na sua ascensão meteórica, culminando numa atuação inovadora e controversa que se repercute por todo o mundo.

programme.title: 28 Anos Depois
programme.desc: Um grupo de sobreviventes do vírus da raiva vive numa pequena ilha. Quando um dos membros do grupo deixa a ilha numa missão ao continente, descobre segredos, maravilhas e horrores que mutaram não só os infetados, mas também outros sobreviventes.

programme.title: Plano General
programme.desc: 'Sufrí una agresión sexual con 6 años que ha marcado mi vida', confiesa la actriz y periodista, que se define como 'una activista cultural que confía en la revolución del amor'

programme.title: Metropolis
programme.desc: Metrópolis dedica su emisión al cineasta belga Olivier Smolders, quien, a lo largo de más de cuatro décadas, ha construido una de las filmografías más singulares y enigmáticas del cine europeo, a medio camino entre el ensayo, la ficción y la experimentación visual.

programme.title: Viaje Al Centro De La Tele
programme.desc: Un viaje en el recuerdo de las mujeres que aportaron su trabajo, su talento y su determinación para hacer una televisión cada vez más moderna, divertida y pegada a la realidad.

programme.desc: Das profundezas da terra aos píncaros da alta sociedade, 'Santa Bárbara' conta a história de Gabriela, uma jovem a quem tiram tudo e que regressa para tudo reconquistar. Ao mesmo tempo, é a história de uma esquecida vila portuguesa do interior que vai encontrar um novo fôlego com a reabertura de umas antigas minas de ouro. Tal como a protagonista, que irá passar das maiores provações às maiores riquezas.

programme.title: A Impostora - Ep. 100
programme.desc: Inspirada em factos reais, aborda temas pertinentes da sociedade, mostrando a luta permanente de pessoas que têm amor ao poder e pessoas que têm o poder de amar. Um avião desaparece misteriosamente, levando a bordo a irmã gémea de Verónica, vítima dum embuste de um milionário. Dada como morta, Verónica assume a identidade da irmã e deseja vingar-se da família do empresário.

programme.title: TV Shop
programme.desc: Aspiradores mais potentes do que o motor de um avião, colchões insufláveis, máquinas que transformam a flácida barriga em portentosos abdominais e mais, muito mais, à distância de um telefonema.

programme.title: Os Batanetes
programme.desc: Vários momentos de humor, compostos por sketches hilariantes, são sinónimo de muitas gargalhadas na companhia dos 'Batanetes'.

programme.desc: Os primeiros anos dos heróis de Madagascar Alex o Leão, Marty a Zebra, Melman a Girafa e Gloria a hipopótamo, ao crescerem no Zoológico do Central Park.

programme.title: A Sentença
programme.desc: Perante casos impetuosos que poderiam ser retirados da vida real, em cada episódio é apresentada uma nova situação, proporcionando debates intensos e análises cuidadosas das evidências e testemunhos. Nesta sala de tribunal, o juiz vai deliberar, com base no código penal, quem é culpado e quem é inocente.

programme.desc: Mariana é uma jovem humilde, mas cheia de espírito, deixada sozinha e vulnerável após a morte da sua avó. Por um capricho do destino, cruza o caminho de Don Alberto Salvatierra, um empresário rico e influente.

programme.title: A Última Porta - Ep. 44
programme.desc: “Já bati em tantas portas” - esta é uma frase que frequentemente ouvimos de pessoas que se encontram numa busca incessante por uma solução para os seus problemas. Mas imagine que na última tentativa por uma mudança e mesmo quando todas as portas parecem estar fechadas, existe uma última porta aberta para o ajudar. A última e a única porta que consegue ser o amparo vitalício para inúmeras pessoas.

programme.title: Saindo Da Depressão - Ep. 152
programme.desc: A depressão, para além de ser a doença do século, afeta milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Sintomas como tristeza constante, desânimo, falta de vontade para viver são sentimentos de quem sofre com depressão. Sendo este um problema sério com urgente resolução, o programa Saindo da Depressão tem sido a alavanca de mudança para inúmeras pessoas que superaram esta patologia, que infelizmente ainda mata.

programme.title: Nosso Tempo - Ep. 130

Temos todos os ingredientes necessários para começar bem o dia!.

programme.desc: Portugal resistiu toda a Segunda Guerra Mundial sem disparar um único tiro. Apanhado entre o Eixo e os Aliados, Salazar recorreu a todas as manobras possíveis para que o país escapasse incólume.

programme.title: Por Detrás da Máscara de Ferro
programme.desc: Chegados a consenso quanto ao seu nome, os historiadores continuam a discordar quanto à verdadeira identidade do indivíduo. Seria um simples criado? Ou seria parente de sangue do Rei Sol?

programme.desc: Têm-lhe atribuído a previsão certeira de eventos cruciais da História, da Revolução Francesa aos ataques terroristas do 11 de Setembro e até ao coronavírus. Como conseguiu prever tantas catástrofes?.
